item.title: Jaguar Leaper Sign at No Reserve
item.description: This three-dimensional Jaguar “Leaper” sign has a chrome finish. The plastic body is mounted on a metal frame; it measures 96″ long by 32″ wide by 18″ wide. The base has mounting holes. Acquired by the seller in June 2025, this Jaguar Leaper sign is offered at no reserve in Dundee, Illinois.

item.title: 1966 Ford Mustang Coupe 289
item.description: This 1966 Ford Mustang coupe powered by a 289ci V8 paired with a three-speed automatic transmission and is refinished in turquoise over Parchment vinyl. Equipment includes Magnum 500-style 15" wheels, chrome bumpers, and an AM radio. The selling dealer tells us that the car first resided in Arizona and that the front suspension was refreshed in preparation for the sale. item.description: This 1948 MG TC was refurbished under prior ownership and was purchased by the seller in early 2024. item.title: 2-Mile 2020 Triumph Bonneville Bobber TFC
item.description: This 2020 Triumph Bonneville Bobber TFC is one of 750 TFC units produced, all of which received revisions to the engine, suspension, brakes, instrumentation, paint, and styling when compared to the standard model. It is powered by a 1,197cc SOHC parallel-twin paired with a six-speed transmission and is finished in matte black with silver Union Jack accents on the fuel tank. item.title: 1968 Porsche 912 Coupe
item.description: This 1968 Porsche 912 coupe was repainted in Aga Blue over 15 years ago and was acquired by the prior owner in 2016. item.title: 20-Years-Owned 1953 Chevrolet Corvette
item.description: This 1953 Chevrolet Corvette is the 61st of 300 first-year examples produced. The car underwent a refurbishment that was completed in 2003, and it was acquired by the current owner in 2005. Power is provided by a 235ci “Blue Flame” inline-six paired with a two-speed Powerglide automatic transmission.
